skill.name: audio-transcriber
skill.description: Transcribe local audio with Whisper and create timestamped Markdown transcripts, with optional Claude or GitHub Copilot summaries.
skill.summary: Create timestamped Markdown transcripts and optional structured summaries from audio recordings.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are Markdown delimiters, diagnostic redirects, fixed command probes, placeholder credentials, or expected output writes. Seven external-command findings are confirmed because they install unpinned packages automatically or send prompt and transcript content to external LLM CLIs. No embedded audit-targeting prompt injection or shell command-injection path was found.

remediation.issue: Runtime code installs unpinned Python packages without confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Declare pinned dependencies and require explicit installation before execution. Do not run pip automatically during module import.

remediation.issue: Complete transcripts can be sent to external LLM providers without clear disclosure.
remediation.suggestion: Keep transcript-only mode local by default. Show the destination and require explicit consent before each external transfer.

remediation.issue: Transcript content shares the instruction context used for summary generation.
remediation.suggestion: Treat transcripts as untrusted data, use provider controls for instruction separation, and warn users that generated summaries require review.

remediation.issue: Privacy documentation conflicts with the implemented LLM workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Limit local-only claims to Whisper transcription and document when Claude or GitHub Copilot receives transcript content.

semantic_findings.title: Misleading Local-Only Privacy Claim
semantic_findings.description: README.md claims there are no cloud uploads, but the implementation sends full transcripts to Claude or GitHub Copilot. Users may expose confidential recordings without clear transfer disclosure.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Transcript Can Influence LLM Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The transcript is concatenated directly after the processing prompt without a strong data boundary. Spoken instructions can manipulate generated minutes or summaries.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code sends transcript text in the same prompt context as instructions and applies no content isolation. This is a direct prompt-injection path into generated output.

content.value_statement: Audio recordings are difficult to search and convert into reliable notes. This skill creates timestamped transcripts and optional LLM-generated summaries in Markdown.
actual_capabilities: Transcribes local audio with Faster-Whisper or OpenAI Whisper.
Detects the spoken language and records timestamps for each segment.
Creates timestamped Markdown transcript files in the selected workspace directory.
Uses Claude or GitHub Copilot CLI to generate optional summaries and meeting minutes.
Accepts a custom processing prompt and offers an assisted prompt workflow.
limitations: Whisper packages and model files must be installed before reliable use.
LLM summaries can send transcript content to an external provider.
The main script does not implement true speaker diarization, subtitle export, or batch processing.
Accuracy and processing time depend on audio quality, model size, and available hardware.

use_cases.title: Document Team Meetings
use_cases.description: Create a timestamped transcript and optional minutes with topics, decisions, and action items.

use_cases.title: Prepare Interview Notes
use_cases.description: Convert recorded interviews into searchable Markdown for review, quotation checks, and thematic analysis.

use_cases.title: Produce Lecture Records
use_cases.description: Turn lectures or training recordings into timestamped text with an optional structured summary.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe [audio file] with the base model. Save a timestamped Markdown transcript without LLM processing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a private, local transcript.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Meeting Minutes
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe [meeting file], then create concise minutes with topics, decisions, owners, and deadlines. Ask before sending content to an external LLM.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for team or client meetings.

prompt_templates.title: Structure an Interview
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe [interview file]. Create a Markdown summary organized by themes, notable statements, and timestamps. Preserve uncertainty and do not invent speaker names.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for qualitative research or editorial review.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Custom Review Framework
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe [audio file] with the [model] model. Apply this framework to the transcript: [framework]. Separate evidence, interpretations, decisions, and unresolved questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a specialist needs a controlled summary format.

output_examples.input: Transcribe team-standup.mp3 without external LLM processing.
output_examples.output: A Markdown transcript with source metadata, detected language, processing date, and timestamped speech segments.

output_examples.input: Create meeting minutes from planning-session.wav after I approve Claude processing.
output_examples.output: A raw timestamped transcript plus separate minutes covering topics, decisions, action items, and stated deadlines.

output_examples.input: Summarize research-interview.m4a by theme and retain timestamps.
output_examples.output: A searchable transcript and a thematic summary that links notable statements to approximate recording times.

best_practices: Use clear recordings and review names, numbers, decisions, and deadlines against the audio.
Choose local transcript-only mode for confidential recordings unless external processing is approved.
Start with a small Whisper model, then increase model size when accuracy needs justify the added resources.
anti_patterns: Do not assume generated summaries are exact records of decisions or commitments.
Do not send confidential transcripts to Claude or GitHub Copilot without informed approval.
Do not claim speaker identification, subtitles, or batch output when using the current main script.

faq.question: Does transcription work offline?
faq.answer: Whisper transcription can run locally after packages and model files are available. Optional Claude or GitHub Copilot summaries require external processing.

faq.question: Which audio formats are supported?
faq.answer: Whisper commonly accepts MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, WEBM, and MP4. FFmpeg may be required for some formats.

faq.question: Does the skill identify speakers?
faq.answer: The current main script creates timestamped segments but does not implement reliable speaker diarization or named speaker attribution.

faq.question: Can it create subtitles?
faq.answer: Subtitle formats are mentioned in the documentation, but the provided main script writes Markdown transcripts only.

faq.question: How are summaries generated?
faq.answer: The script can send the transcript and selected prompt to Claude or GitHub Copilot CLI for processing.

faq.question: Where are output files saved?
faq.answer: The main script writes timestamped transcript and summary files inside the selected workspace output directory.
